Agentic LLM Application Stack

A practical architecture for text, voice, workflows, agents, retrieval, MCP plugins, monitoring, and production controls.

Design rule Use workflows for reliable paths, agents for ambiguous paths, MCP for interoperability, RAG for context, and evals for trust.

Vendor SDKs

OpenAI Agents SDK, Claude Code SDK, and Google ADK are strongest when you want tight alignment with each vendor's model, tool, voice, and deployment ecosystem.

Open Source

LangGraph is the default for explicit graph control. LlamaIndex is excellent when the agent is mainly over data. AutoGen fits multi-agent experimentation.

Architecture Bias

Keep first-party business logic deterministic. Put agents at the uncertain edges: planning, research, triage, tool selection, synthesis, and exception handling.

Logos are loaded from Simple Icons/CDN where available; fallback marks are used for tools without a stable CDN logo.
